mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint declines in HOUST and RSAFS produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a federal funds rate increase signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS rise is below 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 112.0 (index) indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth above 112.0 does not correlate with positive 20-day SPX returns in >55% of periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1000.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a labor market anomaly where shrinking employment coincides with tighter labor conditions, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint declines in PAYEMS and UNRATE produce positive 20-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.
